summary: Tested Perpustakaan Dokumen (Document Library) feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passing (list/upload/download/delete, 2MB size limit, admin vs user role gating, unauth 401). Frontend: full admin flow (upload with title, oversize client-side rejection with correct toast, blob download with original filename, confirm-delete dialog removes row) and user flow (library visible, no upload/title/delete UI, download available) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 918 lines (>700 limit) - consider splitting into modules (files, services, auth, reports) for maintainability.

Object storage helpers (init_storage/put_object/get_object) use blocking `requests` inside async endpoints; not a bug but for high concurrency an async HTTP client (httpx.AsyncClient) would be preferable.
MAX_FILE_SIZE check reads the entire body into memory before checking size; acceptable at 2MB but worth noting for future increases (use UploadFile.spool + streaming size accumulation).
seed_data_creation: None persistent - all TEST_ prefixed files were uploaded and cleaned up (deleted) during tests.
